label: Gemini 4 Hydrogen in Search
lines: Google moved Search to Gemini 4 Hydrogen worldwide on Nov 17, with better intent understanding and smarter query fan-out.
AIO links and sources changed the same day. Google links out more, and AIOs now show a fully visible citations block.
Recheck AIO citations for priority keywords this week.

label: AI Mode inside Search
lines: Google is rolling out a collapsible sidebar that keeps AI Mode conversations inside the main search results.
Chris Long calls AI Mode the new default. Cyrus Shepard found that opting out of AIOs and AI Mode cut AI impressions to zero and cut organic clicks too.
Do not opt client sites out of Google's AI features, and track AI Mode citations next to organic clicks.

label: November Core Update
lines: The November 2026 Core Update is still rolling out.
SE Ranking shows volatility cooling, most at the very top of the SERP. Google hasn't confirmed it is done.
Wait for the rollout to end before you act on ranking drops.

label: Branded data in the GSC API
lines: The Search Analytics API now classifies queries as branded or non-branded and includes multimodal search data.
It can also filter several countries or devices in one request.
We can pull non-branded clicks without our own regex.

label: ChatGPT Business Hub
lines: ChatGPT Business Hub gives real data, but very little of it.
Barry Schwartz still has zero data after a week. Malte Landwehr says it counts a citation as a mention even when the brand is not named.
One account got 17 clicks that converted at 12%. Do not use these numbers as benchmarks yet.

label: Ads in AI answers
lines: ChatGPT announced ads, and Microsoft confirmed ads in Bing AI Overviews in all markets except China.
Writesonic found sponsored ads in 18.94% of ChatGPT answers on Nov 16 and saw 4,000+ advertisers. But only 6.9% of ChatGPT conversations in a US panel showed purchase intent.
Keep ad budgets on Google Search until ChatGPT ads show real results.

label: Crawlers for AI agents
lines: Google and Microsoft now run crawlers and search engines built for AI agents.
Google published a help doc for Google-Agent, and Microsoft launched Web IQ to ground ChatGPT, Copilot and Mistral. Gemini and Ask Maps can now call local businesses for users.
Check robots.txt rules and server logs for Google-Agent, and keep GBP hours and phone numbers right.

label: Plugin and script security
lines: Four security stories touch client sites this week.
WordPress 7.1.5 fixes 18 flaws, Rank Math had 16 in 2026, an Optimizely script carried malware to 178 organizations, and the FBI tied SEO poisoning to $28 million in ransomware payments.
Update WordPress core and Rank Math, and review third-party scripts on client sites.

label: GPT-6.2 and new models
lines: OpenAI, Microsoft and Google launched new model families this week.
OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Microsoft introduced seven MAI models at Ignite, and Google released Gemini 4 Neon.
OpenAI says Astra writes shorter answers by default, so recheck our saved prompts.

label: Local citations in AI
lines: New data shows which sources Google uses for local businesses in Maps and AI answers.
Whitespark found the business website in 86% of Maps Web Results and Facebook in 41%, across 21,000+ businesses. Dan Hinckley shows a local business named in 94% of Google AI answers after SEO work.
Keep client websites, Facebook pages and core citations complete and correct.
